captions.detailed: A pair of birdwatching roof-prism binoculars featuring olive-green barrels with textured rubber armor and dark gray/black plastic components. The assembly consists of two parallel optical barrels connected by a central bridge containing a revolute hinge for adjusting the interpupillary distance. At the rear, two black rubber eyecups are mounted on sliding prismatic joints for eye relief adjustment, while a central cylindrical focus knob is positioned on a revolute joint on the bridge.
captions.instruction: Create an articulated 3D model of a roof-prism binocular. The assembly should feature two olive-green cylindrical barrels connected by a central hinge, adjustable sliding black eyecups on each eyepiece, and a central revolving focus knob.
captions.factory: The model is built using an ArticulatedObject framework. The main chassis or central bridge acts as the base link. Cylinders are used to model the central hinge and the focus knob, which is attached via a revolute joint. The two main optical barrels are shaped using rounded or lofted cylinders and are connected to the central hinge using revolute joints. The adjustable eyecups are modeled as smaller coaxial cylinders and are attached to the rear of each barrel via prismatic joints.
